explanation: A central figure in Genesis and father to Isaac, regarded as the patriarch of Jews, Christians, and Muslims.
Son of Abraham and Sarah, an important figure in the Bible and counted among the patriarchs of Judaism.
Abraham's wife, mother of Isaac, and a significant female figure in the Bible.
Sarah's Egyptian servant, mother of Ishmael, and a central character in the story of Abraham and his descendants.
Son of Abraham and Hagar, considered the ancestor of the Arabs and an important figure in Islamic tradition.
An agreement or bond between God and people, often linked to promises and blessings from God.
A source of water, vital for survival and life in desert regions, also symbolizing God's care and provision.
A people who lived in the coastal areas southwest of Canaan, frequently in conflict with Israel in biblical history.
